note: Young wizard, front view, hatless, long blue robe, a wooden staff with a big open ring head held in the left (image-left) fist. Head is the brown hair, ears and full beard, bottom y~445 at the beard tip; the blue robe, belt, the white lining at the left hem and the robe panel hanging at the right hip (x550-668, y652-750) are torso. Left arm: a narrow bell sleeve hangs at the left body edge (x322-386, y458-596): the upper part to y~546 is the upper arm, the lower part is the forearm pointing left behind the staff, and the bare fist (x240-304, y495-556) with the thumb on the far side of the shaft (x298-322, y482-508) is the hand; the elbow is a guess because the sleeve marks nothing. The staff is equipment: the ring head and the shaft above the fist (x140-302, y230-500), the bit of shaft between the fingers and the sleeve (y505-548) and the shaft below the fist down to y~776, kept off the fist. Right arm: bell sleeve upper arm to the bulge at y~555 (elbow), lower sleeve forearm to the wrist y~600, bare hand y596-658. Long robe: hip is the hem y~765; the tan strips of skin just below it are the thigh (to y~784, the boot tops, which are above halfway so the knees); boots are lower leg to the ankles (left y~803, right y~815), toes are feet.
